title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — October 17, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B8.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.6 (Peaked October 17, 2026 at 09:41 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C6.0 (Peaked October 16, 2026 at 19:14 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 418 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)

How's the Sun looking from where you are? 🖤

Today’s solar images show two active regions alongside a broad, elongated coronal-hole feature, while the surrounding corona appears otherwise routine.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
